BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Vulture!!
Luckily they fell on a sandy surface.\nPelulu seems to be alive....\nBut, what about Balft...?
Well, well, well...if he's that desperate and\nwants to die that much, bring it on then!\nI'll stop him no matter what...Let's go!!
Geez! He's going off on his own again!!
Balft is all worn out, the end of the ax in his\ngrip has turned blunt and the tip of the\nspear-like part is broken...
Balft, look at yourself! You're all tuckered out!!\nMoreover, there's no way you can fight properly\nwith such an ax!
Hiyaaaaa!!
Ough!!
It's over...\nLet me finish you off with a peck!
What are you doing!\nRun! Now! Quickly!!
Bwahaha! You know you can't run from me anymore?!\nSince you're being a good loser, I'll reward you\nwith a quick and painless death!!
Oh my gosh...I-I feel so numbbbb
W-what the...This is ridiculous...
You rascal...I won't let you stop me from\nattacking El Scaro!!
You don't have any weapons, do you?!\nSo just take a rest over there.\nDon't even think of escaping!!
Huff...hufff...Y-you sure gave us a hard time.\nBut, this is it!
Mwahahaha...what a fool! You're such an idiot for\nleaving an unarmed human alone!!\nI'll drag him to hell!
Dodge ittttttt!!
No, dooooon't!!
Ah, ugghhhh!!
Oh, so you have another weapon!\nYou've got me confused for a second...
No, I didn't take it out.\nIt just came out of nowhere...
Whaat?? Is that...
It's Felien's sword...
What did you sayy?!
Hiyaaaaa!!
Aghhhh!!
Why are you doing this...?!
Why are you acting so desperate!\nThanks to you, I got into big trouble too!!
I know you feel like there's no point in living\nafter losing the people you have bonded with in\nthe past.
But, what about Triet who relies on you?\nWhat about us and the king who have also formed a\nbond with you? You wanna make us desperate too?!
Besides, didn't Felien's sword just protect you?
I hate and don't believe in spirits of the dead,\nbut don't you think Felien saved you because she\ndidn't want you to die either?
Uh...
Uh...\nHuuh...huuh *sob*
If you really wanna thank Felien,\nplease live until you die.\nWe're taking you to Triet now, okay?
Is there anything left undone?\n*[ffff64]Your choice makes no difference to the story[ffffff].
Nothing! Let's go to El Scaro!
Explore the desert a little longer!
